items.title: We match you with qualified professionals

items.question: How quickly can you fill a role?
items.answer: We typically fill roles within 24–72 hours, depending on location, role type, and urgency. Our team prioritizes your request and provides timely updates to ensure continuity of care.

items.question: What credentials do your nurses have?
items.answer: All of our nurses are fully licensed to practice in their respective provinces. Credentials are verified upon onboarding and include background checks, vulnerable sector screening, CPR/First Aid, immunization records, and specialty certifications when applicable.

items.question: Do you provide staffing in rural or remote areas?
items.answer: Yes. We provide staffing support to rural and remote communities across Canada, including fly-in locations and underserved regions. Our mobile and travel healthcare teams are equipped to deliver care where it’s needed most.

items.question: Can we hire temporary staff permanently?
items.answer: Yes, we do have an option for that. Many of our clients begin with short-term contracts and later transition top-performing staff into permanent roles through our contract-to-hire model.
